
{{alias}}( descriptors, offsets )
    Sets ndarray descriptor index offsets.

    The function mutates the provided descriptors.

    Parameters
    ----------
    descriptors: ArrayLike<ndarrayLike>
        List of ndarray descriptors.

    offsets: ArrayLike<integer>
        Index offsets.

    Returns
    -------
    out: ArrayLike<ndarrayLike>
        Input array.

    Examples
    --------
    // Create an ndarray:
    > var x = {{alias:@stdlib/ndarray/zeros}}( [ 3, 3, 3 ] );

    // Convert to a descriptor object:
    > var desc = {{alias:@stdlib/ndarray/base/ndarraylike2descriptor}}( x );

    // Adjust the offset:
    > var out = {{alias}}( [ desc ], [ 1 ] );

    See Also
    --------
